conbody.p: The green indicator () light blinks on the instrument cluster, and the steering wheel makes adjustments to keep the vehicle inside the lane.
Lane Keeping Assist can activate in the following conditions.

li.p: Your driving speed: Approximately 60-200 km/h (40-120 mph)
Road conditions meet the operating requirements (e.g., lane width, road curvature, etc.)

note.p: Lane Keeping Assist will not operate when the vehicle speed is below 55 km/h (35 mph) or exceeds 210 km/h (130 mph).
